text:
Sam: Dropping a tiny managerone-page kit for goals + feedback you can paste into 1:1s. One objective, 1-2 KRs, and a small QA script.

Aisha: love it. can you show a short career goal example vs a delivery goal?

Sam: sure. Career (one-liner): Objective: Develop cross-team stakeholder influence by leading 2 RFCs (#career). KR1: Lead 2 RFCs with documented decisions; KR2: Run 4 stakeholder syncs with >80% attendance.
Delivery (one-liner): Objective: Reduce onboarding drop-off from 18% to <=10%. KR1: Increase day-1 completion from 62% to 78%; KR2: Ship guided tour by 10/15.

Rae: If a goal needs paid training or extra headcount, how should I flag it? managers forget.

Sam: Add a tag on the objective line: [budget-request] or [headcount-request] + one-line reason. HR will triage if present. Example: Objective... Owner: Lina [budget-request: course X, $1,200].

Aisha: micro-feedback prompts for peers? keep it 1-2 lines please.

Sam: Paste these: 1) "One result I noticed this cycle: ..." 2) "One way they unblocked me: ..." 3) "One skill to grow next quarter: ..."

Rae: manager scripts for vagueness or mid-quarter pivots? I always stumble.

Sam: Vague: "Which metric will tell us this worked?" Too many KRs: "Let's pick the 1-2 outcomes that matter this quarter." Mid-pivot: "Context changed because [reason]. Proposed change: [new KR]. Approve?"
